articles.title: Moe, Doerkson urge unity to Smith’s UCP at kickoff for annual meeting
articles.summary: The UCP gathered in Calgary weeks after Albertans rejected another separation referendum, as internal divisions over the independence movement linger.

articles.title: Kakko scores twice in third as Kraken beat Oilers
articles.summary: Kaapo Kakko scored two third-period goals two minutes apart as the Seattle Kraken rallied to beat the Edmonton Oilers 4-2 on Friday.

articles.title: Connor scores twice, Winnipeg Jets win again, beating Islanders 3-1 on Long Island
articles.summary: Kyle Connor scored his 21st and 22nd of the season while Stuart Skinner stopped 26 shots as the Jets improved to 10-1-1 in their last 12 games.

articles.title: Quebec physician burnout jumps to 80%: CMA
articles.summary: The association said one in two physicians screened positive for depression, while reports of suicidal thoughts doubled and now exceed levels recorded during the pandemic.

articles.title: Raptors beat Nets but are still out of NBA Cup
articles.summary: If the Toronto Raptors were disappointed to be bounced from the NBA Cup, they weren't going to show it.

articles.title: Calgarian with Tourette syndrome interrupted by councillor during budget public hearing
articles.summary: In an interview with Global News, Matthew Riley said the situation has left him hurt and embarrassed, and thinking twice about speaking to Calgary city council again

articles.title: Significant investment to address public safety in Kelowna’s 2027 draft budget
articles.summary: Kelowna's new council is preparing to make significant spending decisions, with budget deliberations set to begin next week.

articles.title: Interpol joins search for 2 Edmonton kids allegedly kidnapped by father in August
articles.summary: Police believe Scot MacDermid may have left or will try to leave Canada, and are working with Interpol to find him and the children: nine-year-old Lesley and six-year-old George.

articles.title: Quebec Court of Appeal to rule Monday on oath to the King by legislators
articles.summary: The decision will come a day before the legislature is scheduled to resume parliamentary work.

articles.title: Marcel Colomb First Nation in Manitoba declares state of emergency over water
articles.summary: A First Nation in northern Manitoba has declared a state of emergency over what it says is unsafe drinking water.
